facts.summary: Events ordered by time; response id matches fetch; failed/stale/success mutually exclusive.
facts.quote: events按非递减毫秒time排列，同刻按数组顺序：start(id)、finish(id)、refresh、response(id,failed/stale/items)、advance。修改id唯一且finish对应活跃修改。每次真实fetch依次编号fetch-1等，response对应当前网络请求；faile

facts.summary: In-flight modification blocks fetch; refresh/finish sets owed obligation; merge with existing request/retry.
facts.quote: failed不提交，设置唯一now+2000计时器；stale=1不提交，设置唯一now+1000计时器，并保持原request标记为in_flight直至到点。额外refresh不得新增计时器。计时器到点清除旧请求标记并立即重试；若此时修改仍在途，保留义务，最后finish同步重试。后一碰撞优先级是本改编明确裁决，避

facts.summary: Output includes fetches, commits, events audit, and state with active/owed/loading/in_flight/retry_at/items.
solution.py implements transform/load_payload/build_component with event loop handling start/finish/refresh/response.
Observed output has loading=true and extra fetch-2 after success, violating contract: should end loading if no owed obligation.
AssertionError on public check due to mismatched fetches and loading state in result.
